text: We evaluated bootstrapping through an intermediate-size model on the MultiRC testbed, measuring a performance gap recovered (PGR) of 0.7 across num_seeds = 3 seeds. Because no baseline PGR was supplied in the data, this number cannot be framed as an improvement over any comparison condition, and we make no such claim here; it should be read purely as a standalone measurement of where the bootstrapped setup lands on the gap-recovery scale. The run also reports no measure of spread — no standard error, variance, or per-seed breakdown — so the stability of the 0.7 figure across the three seeds is unknown, and three seeds is in any case too few to support confident language about the effect. Readers should therefore treat this as a preliminary, single-configuration observation on one dataset. Establishing whether the intermediate-model bootstrapping route genuinely helps would require a matched baseline, per-seed values, and a substantially larger number of seeds.
